steps.question: What is the main content?
steps.why: Most screens are forms and steps.

steps.question: Which text roles does it need?

steps.use: type.label, above the field, always visible
steps.why: Labels must stay visible while typing.

steps.rule: A recessed fill, a step below content.
steps.pick: neutral.100, a step below content (1.17:1 on surface.default), so table headers and wells read as recessed.
steps.darkPick: neutral.100, a step below content (1.16:1 on surface.default), so table headers and wells read as recessed.

steps.pick: neutral.700: supporting text, 12.63:1 on surface.default, above the 7:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.700: supporting text, 12.68:1 on surface.default, above the 7:1 floor.

steps.question: How much is on one screen?
steps.why: One question per screen lowers effort.
Large rows are easy to read and tap.
Every number must be readable at large size.

steps.rule: Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.
steps.pick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.36:1, on surface.canvas). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.
steps.darkPick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.46:1, on surface.default). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.

steps.pick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 18.42:1 on surface.default, above the 7:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.2:1 on surface.default, above the 7:1 floor.

steps.pick: atkinson-hyperlegible for data text: Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything: it was drawn so letters can't be mistaken, and nobody is left out.

steps.question: How many signals carry each meaning?

steps.why: Selection never relies on color alone.

steps.rule: The fill of a selected or current item, or a toggle that is on.
steps.pick: blue.light.100: a tint of the brand, 1.18:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.
steps.darkPick: blue.dark.100: a tint of the brand, 1.21:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.

steps.rule: The edge that marks a selected item, beside its fill, so selection is never color alone.
steps.pick: blue.light.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 7.26:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: blue.dark.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 8.74:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
